I'm creating this Rmd file specifically for the purpose of exploring the values that appear
in the note columns of the coral dataset.

I'll use the tidied dataset to do this exploration.

```{r}
# clean env
rm(list = ls())

# load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# Load tidy data
coral_df_tidy <- read_csv(here("data", "coral_tidy_2024.csv"))

```

```{r}
# Filter for values where year is at least 2019
# Set to lower case
unique_note_vals_2019_onwards <- coral_df_tidy %>%
  filter(year >= 2019) %>% 
  select(note, note_extra) %>% 
  gather() %>% 
  pull() %>% 
  unique()
```
